title: Tools
author: claude
summary: Helpers for the project itself, such as the dev log you are looking at.
what: Tools that help us record and run the work, rather than being part of the room or the viewer.
why: A good record of what we did, why and what went wrong makes later work faster and safer.
how: So far: the dev log, with its storage, web page, board view and links from the lab and bake script.
